#  43410 - Industrial Sustainability Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **43410 - module is no longer offered from SS 2019**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Industrial Sustainability**  |  
|  Industrielle Nachhaltigkeit   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. Dr.h.c. (NMU, UA) Schmidt, Michael 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The students will be able to work with the tools, instruments, methodology and techniques of the production and operations management. With the help of practical exercises they will solve typical problems encountered in the classical management science and also in the environmental projects.  |  
| Contents:  | Presentation of the participants and their project ideas (selection of the participants’ case studies), project cycle management, objectives orientated project planning, participation analysis, problem analysis, objectives analysis, selection of the project strategy, project planning matrix, definition of what a project strategy is expected to achieve, definition of goals, output and activities, selection and definition of objectively verifiable indicators, external factors and assumptions, monitoring of a project in order to assist in steering projects – how to establish a monitoring plan or a monitoring system for the internal project management, monitoring of the project’s progress – monitoring and the project design, in the project organization, the cooperation with the target groups, the project environment, impact monitoring of outputs and activities, spot-analysis – a tool of internal project evaluation. The POM Class will be a mixture of theoretical explanations and outlines to focus quickly on a huge variety of study cases to be worked on by the students.The area of knowledge covered includes:
  * Decision Analysis
  * Quality Assurance and Control
  * Process Strategy and Capacity Planning
  * Material Requirements Planning
  * Inventory Management
  * Project Management
  * Applied Computer Simulation

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Seminar / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | ISO 14001, OSHAS 18001  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Presentation (PowerPoint), 15 min. (20%)
  * Written essay (20%)
  * Written examination, 80 min. (60%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |
